answer: Cap paid seats instead of policing identities. Each epoch the network auctions a fixed number of work slots at one uniform clearing price, so a thousand fake accounts must buy a thousand slots, each earning no more than an honest one. Picture a garden trellis with a set number of rungs: extra vines gain no extra light. Whether the job is a sonnet or a code audit, splitting into more names costs as much as it pays, and the attack has no margin.
